pr_title: Fix possible infinite loop in pem_read_bio_key_decoder()
pr_body:
There could be an infinite loop if no read happened.

Fixes #15426
pr_comments: Is a test case useful for this?
If I add a test case then without this fix it will just hang in the test. Do we want such testcase? But yeah, probably worth it anyway.
I think a test is useful.  Sure it will hang but that's better than a user encountering the same thing in production.

> Please add a test case.

Done.
@paulidale The test case detected the #15442 as well, so I've fixed it too. Please re-review.
Aargh, the fips checksums seem to never be right.

24 hours has passed since 'approval: done' was set, but as this PR has been updated in that time the label 'approval: ready to merge' is not being automatically set.  Please review the updates and set the label manually.
Merged to master. Thank you for the reviews.

issue_context.title: Infinite loop in decoders

review_comments: Should you be using a libctx here - just in case this affects other tests that could get added later.
The provider is unloaded later. The NULL libctx is supposed to have only the null provider loaded so loading/unloading the default provider should not affect the other tests.
